title: Training-free motion correction for cardiac T1 mapping using DINOv3 features

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Training-free motion correction for cardiac T1 mapping using DINOv3 features》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Cardiac T1 mapping is susceptible to respiratory motion, particularly due to the substantial contrast variations and signal inversions across different inversion times (TI).

evidence.text: Cardiac T1 mapping is susceptible to respiratory motion, particularly due to the substantial contrast variations and signal inversions across different inversion times (TI).

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Training-free motion correction for cardiac T1 mapping using DINOv3 features》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】This study proposes a novel training-free motion correction framework leveraging frozen DINOv3 foundation model features to achieve robust myocardial alignment without task-specific network training or fine-tuning.

【Abstract · abstract-1-8】Our framework provides solution for cardiac T1 mapping, improving structural alignment under intensity variations without requiring large-scale annotated training data.

evidence.text: This study proposes a novel training-free motion correction framework leveraging frozen DINOv3 foundation model features to achieve robust myocardial alignment without task-specific network training or fine-tuning.
Our framework provides solution for cardiac T1 mapping, improving structural alignment under intensity variations without requiring large-scale annotated training data.
